check.why: Replots one deck from stored results, no re-fit, and shows whether the 4 pt stamp sits clear of the axis and digits at the default panel size.

meaning: The comment fixes the stamp font at 4 pt integer, justified by a measurement that a 600x400 panel leaves a ~6 px band that 4 pt fills exactly and 5 pt overflows. It also claims every explicit deck size is larger, so the smallest default panel is the binding case.
expectation: Unknown in magnitude. If the 6 px band figure is off, or some deck sets a size below 600x400, the stamp can collide with the axis or the digits on those panels. A non-integer size would silently be read as a rotation and leave 14 pt text.

could_move.what: The stamp is on the shared plotting path, so the claim binds all decks, not one.
Montage/beat rows stamp at one size and re-render at another; if any re-render target is smaller than 600x400 the 'smallest panel' claim fails.
Deck panels that do not set `size` inherit the 600x400 default the measurement was taken against.
